items.title: Show HN: Rivermark, a superfast AI graphic design canvas
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
Agents can nowadays design UI very competently, but the wider question of graphic design is largely unsolved.
On one side, you have image models like ChatGPT images, which are high-quality but recognizable and barely editable. On the other hand, you can use LLMs and accept results that, well, look like UI.

items.title: Show HN: Alternative to Nvidia Auto-Ontology
items.contentSnippet:
This repo provides an alternative to the ontology compiling capabilities of NVIDA Auto-Ontology.
The main difference is that it builds the ontology from most of your existing data assets (transformation code, dashboards, docs), instead of building it from your warehouse and semantic layer only.
